summary: @or-sdk/password preinstall downloads Bun runtime and executes obfuscated payload
details: package.json declares `preinstall: node setup.mjs`. setup.mjs is itself obfuscated (hex-named identifiers, inlined string lookup objects) and, on `npm install`, downloads the Bun runtime binary from GitHub releases for the current platform, extracts and chmods the `bun` executable, and runs it against a sibling file `math_init.js`. `math_init.js` is a 727KB single-line heavily-obfuscated blob (string-array + rotation obfuscator, hex-named variables, encoded literals) unrelated to the advertised password-SDK purpose of the package and never referenced from the library's main entry. The alternate-runtime choice specifically causes the payload to execute under an interpreter that Node-based static tooling does not observe. The behavior fires automatically at install time without user consent and is inconsistent with any legitimate need of a password utility.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
